name: io.github.ezolabs/ezo-watcher
title: EZO Watcher
description: Self-hosted monitoring your coding agent installs, proves and fixes. Alert wall, pager, MCP.

packageArguments.name: --dir
packageArguments.description: The project directory that holds .watcher/ (watcher init writes it). Defaults to the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHER_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token for the running Watcher's /mcp endpoint. When unset it is read from the project's .watcher/.env.
